info.name: customer-routes
info.description:
# customer-routes Postman Collection

Comprehensive Postman collection containing customer routes across:
- `customerAuth.js` (Better Auth phone OTP authentication & session management)
- `profile.routes.js` (Customer profile updates: name, email, address, addresses)
- `cart.routes.js` (Customer cart operations)
- `wishlist.routes.js` (Customer wishlist operations)
- `review.routes.js` (Authenticated customer product reviews)
- `customerImage.routes.js` (Customer image uploads)
- `public.routes.js` (Public storefront browsing & public reviews)

## Authentication & Headers
Requests automatically include `Origin: {{customerOrigin}}` (default `http://localhost:3000`) in pre-request scripts to satisfy backend CORS policy. Authentication uses HttpOnly cookies managed automatically by Postman's Cookie Jar.
